title: Leo: shining,
but feeling empty?
summary: Everyone sees you shining, and inside it feels hollow. Why that is for a Leo Moon, why it changes on December 5, and what the next two months hold.
film: Leo: everyone sees you shining. So why do you feel empty?
imageAlt: Maya holding a Leo flag, with the lion beside her
inside: Why success can feel strangely empty for a Leo Moon right now
What changes on December 5, December 10 and January 24
Seven dates to plan around, and four small things to do
intro: If you are a Leo by Moon sign, the last year and a half may have had a strange flavour. From the outside things can look fine, even good: people notice you, you get things done, and luck has been gathering around you lately. Inside, though, it can feel quiet, distant, a little hollow, as if you are watching your own life from a few steps away.

You are not imagining it, and nothing is wrong with you. The tradition has a clear reason for that feeling, and a clear date when it moves on: December 5. Here is what is going on, what changes, and how to use the next two months well.

sections.label: The empty feeling
title: Why it feels
hollow inside.
paragraphs: Since May 18, 2025, the calm, detached influence the tradition calls the tail of the dragon has been sitting on your Moon sign. It is pictured as a body with no head: it does not crave, it does not chase, it does not need applause. When it sits on the Moon, the sign of your feelings, it is read as a stretch of detachment. Praise lands softly, wins feel smaller than they should, and you may catch yourself asking what any of it is for.

For a sign that runs on warmth and being seen, that is an odd combination. It is also useful. This influence strips away what you were only doing for show, so that what is left is what you truly care about. Many Leos come out of this stretch knowing themselves better than before.

There is a second reason the feeling is so sharp right now. Since October 31, the planet of luck and growth has been on your sign too. So the outside has been bright while the inside has been quiet. That is the exact mix of shining and empty that so many Leos describe.

sections.label: December 5
title: The empty spell
moves on.
paragraphs: On Saturday, December 5, the detached influence leaves your sign and moves into your house of rest, the twelfth house, where it stays for about a year and a half. The tradition reads this as feeling more like yourself again: your feelings come back into colour, and what you enjoy starts to feel enjoyable.

In your house of rest it takes a gentler form. It is read as a good time for sleep, quiet, retreat, spiritual practice and letting go of what you no longer need. If you have been tired in a way that a weekend does not fix, this is a season that supports real rest.

sections.label: December 5, the same day
title: From partners
to rivals.
paragraphs: The same day, its restless other half, the hungry head of the dragon, leaves your house of partners and enters your house of rivals and daily work, the sixth house. For a year and a half it has been stirring things up in close relationships: intense attractions, confusing signals, or a partner who wanted more than you could give.

In the house of rivals and daily work it is read as one of its best placements. The hunger turns into drive: you are said to outwork competition, handle problems head on and build strong daily habits. Relationships tend to calm down as the pressure moves elsewhere.

sections.label: December 10
title: Deep change
turns forward.
paragraphs: Since March 29, 2025, the slow planet of patience has been in your house of deep change, the eighth house. It is read as a time of inner transformation: old fears come up to be faced, shared money and other people's resources need care, and some things end so that something truer can begin. It stays there through these two months and beyond.

Lately it has been moving backwards, which can make the same worry come round again and again. On December 10 it turns forward. The tradition reads this as things starting to move: decisions that were stuck get made, and the deep work begins to feel productive instead of endless.

sections.label: Now to January 24
title: Your strength:
luck around you.
paragraphs: The planet of luck, wisdom and growth is on your sign until January 24. It is read as warmth, protection and good timing around you: people want to help, doors open, and you look your best. It turns backwards on December 12 while still on your sign, which the tradition reads as a time to review and finish rather than to start something huge.

On January 24 it moves into your house of rest as well, and the start of next year becomes a quieter, more inward season. So the weeks before then are your window to use the goodwill around you: ask for what you need, reconnect with people who believe in you, and say yes to the opportunities already in front of you.

rows.note: The empty, detached spell leaves your sign. Restlessness moves away from your relationships and into your work.
In your house of home. A good day to make your space feel like yours again.
A slow, heavy situation starts to move.
In your house of friends and gains. Celebrate with the people who show up for you.
In your house of joy and creativity. Start something just because you love it.
In your house of rest. Slow down and sleep well before the quieter season begins.
Luck moves from your sign into your house of rest.

steps.name: Keep one quiet hour a day
steps.text: No phone, no audience. A walk, a journal, music, prayer, anything that is only for you. It is how you hear what you actually want while things are shifting.

steps.name: Do not judge your life by the hollow feeling
steps.text: Until December 5, try not to make big decisions just because something feels empty. The tradition reads that feeling as a passing influence, not a verdict.

steps.name: Use the goodwill before late January
steps.text: Ask for the introduction, the recommendation or the help. People are said to be especially generous towards you until January 24.

steps.name: Put your fire into work from December
steps.text: Once the restless energy moves into your house of daily work, channel it into one routine or one goal you can win at, and let relationships breathe.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I’m a Leo Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Leo. Many people with a Leo Sun have their Moon somewhere else. Your birth chart shows it in a few seconds.
They are calculated from the planets’ real positions, in US Eastern time, and they are the same for everyone with this Moon sign. What they mean for you in detail depends on the rest of your chart.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
